newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close lower in all months.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close lower in all months.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower in all months on Friday, as price drops in the Chicago corn market overnight triggered active selling, traders said.
Prices were 150 to 470 yen lower, with the benchmark November 1997 contract down 180 yen at 13,950 yen a tonne. Volume was 67,055 lots.

Local investors, discouraged by recent price plunges in the U.S. corn market, continued to sell from the start, traders said. Active long-liquidation depressed nearby months in particular, they said. The Tokyo corn futures market will be closed on Monday due to a national holiday.
The spot December contract on the CBOT Project A trading corn system was being traded at $2.65 per bushel at 0850 GMT, against $2.66 at Thursday's close.
The spot November of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system was at $6.66 at 0855 GMT, against $6.67-3/4 at Thursday's close.
